translations.1: And from the blue and the purple and the scarlet dye, they made embroidered garments for service in the sanctuary; and they made the sacred garments which are for Aaron — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.2: And he made the ephod of gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet dye, and twisted fine linen.
translations.3: And that was by beating out the sheets of gold thin, and cutting them into threads, and weaving them together with the blue and the purple and the scarlet dye and the fine linen — the work of a skilled craftsman.
translations.4: And they made for it two sewn pockets, and sewed them onto its two edges.
translations.5: And the binding-straps of the ephod which are upon it — like it and of its workmanship — of gold and blue and purple and scarlet dye and twisted fine linen, as God had commanded Moses.
translations.6: And they made the crystal stones, with settings of gold encircling them, engraved upon them as the engraving of a signet — the names of the sons of Israel.
translations.7: And he set them upon the two pockets of the ephod — stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.8: And he made the breastpiece, the work of a skilled craftsman, like the workmanship of the ephod — of gold and blue and purple and scarlet dye and twisted fine linen.
translations.9: And it was, when they made it, square and doubled; its length a span, and its width a span.
translations.10: And they set in it four rows of gems in order: the first row — a red ruby, and an emerald, and a yellow one.
translations.11: And the second row — a deep-blue one, and a white gleaming one, and a bahraman.
translations.12: And the third row — an agate, and a jet, and a turquoise.
translations.13: And the fourth row — a sea-blue, and a crystal, and a jasper; with settings of gold encircling them, in their arrangement.
translations.14: And upon the stones were the names of the sons of Israel — for they are twelve, corresponding to their names — the name of each one engraved as the engraving of a signet upon a stone; thus for the twelve tribes.
translations.15: And they made upon the breastpiece two chains, even and straight, of braided workmanship, of pure gold.
translations.16: And they made settings of gold and two rings of gold, and placed the two rings at the two edges of the breastpiece.
translations.17: And they hung the two braided chains upon the two rings, at the two edges of the breastpiece.
translations.18: And the two other ends of the two braided chains they hung upon the settings, and placed them upon the two pockets of the ephod, on its front side.
translations.19: And they also made two rings of gold and set them at the two edges of the breastpiece, on its border, toward the side of the ephod on the inner side.
translations.20: Then they also made two rings of gold and placed them opposite the two pockets of the ephod, on their lower part toward the front of the ephod, facing its joining, above its binding-straps.
translations.21: And they fastened the breastpiece from its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue, so that it would be above its binding-straps and the breastpiece would not come loose from the ephod — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.22: And he made the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver, entirely of blue.
translations.23: And its opening was in the middle of it, like the opening of a coat of mail, with a border encircling its opening, so that it would not tear.
translations.24: And they made in its hem pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet dye, twisted.
translations.25: And they made bells of pure gold and placed them between the pomegranates, in the hem of the robe, all around, between the pomegranates.
translations.26: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate — in the hem of the robe, all around, for him to serve in it — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.27: And they made the tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons.
translations.28: And the turban of fine linen, and the splendid head-coverings of fine linen, and the trousers of twisted fine linen.
translations.29: And the sash of twisted fine linen and blue and purple and scarlet dye — the work of an embroiderer — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.30: And they made the diadem-band of the sacred crown of pure gold, and engraved upon it a writing as the engraving of a signet: 'Holy to God.'
translations.31: And they hung it with a cord of blue, to be placed upon the turban above the forehead — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.32: And all the work of the tabernacle, the tent of assembly, was completed; and the sons of Israel made it according to all that God had commanded Moses — so they made it.
translations.33: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its vessels — its clasps, its planks, its bars, its pillars, and its bases.
translations.34: And the covering of the tanned ram-skins, and the covering of the daresh-skins, and the screening veil.
translations.35: And the ark of the testimony and its poles, and the cover.
translations.36: And the table and all its vessels, and the bread of presentation.
translations.37: And the pure lampstand, its lamps — the lamps of the arrangement — and all its vessels, and the oil of illumination.
translations.38: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the resinous incense, and the curtain for the entrance of the tent.
translations.39: And the bronze altar and its bronze grating, its poles and all its vessels, and the basin and its stand.
translations.40: And the hangings of the court-enclosure, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain of its gate and its cords and its pegs — and the rest of the vessels of the work of the tabernacle, for the tent of assembly.
translations.41: And the embroidered garments for service in the sanctuary, and the sacred garments for Aaron the imam, and the garments of his sons for the imamate.
translations.42: According to all that God had commanded Moses — so the sons of Israel made all the work.
translations.43: And when Moses saw all the work — and behold, they had made it as God had commanded — Moses bestowed blessing upon them.
